statement: In the matrix-entry embedding over C, deg SO(n)=2^(n−1) det[binom(2n−2i−2j,n−2i)] for 1≤i,j≤floor(n/2). Thus a generic complementary affine linear section has that many complex points. Table 1 lists n=2,…,9 as 2,8,40,384,4768,111616,3433600,196968448.

answer.text: Proves the determinant formula 2^(n−1) det[binom(2n−2i−2j,n−2i)] for deg SO(n).

notes:
Characteristic zero; do not identify this degree with an arbitrary coordinate projection.
